privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.subtitle: What you have agreed to, and the rights you can exercise over the data held about you.
privacy.consent_failed: That preference could not be saved.
privacy.consent_help: Each choice is recorded with the time it was made. Transactional email — sign-in codes, security alerts — is not consent-based and cannot be switched off here.
privacy.export_body: Prepared in the background. You will be emailed when it is ready.
privacy.export_queued: Export started. You will receive an email when it is ready.
privacy.erasure_body: Permanent and irreversible. You will be asked to confirm in writing and re-enter your password.
privacy.policy_versions_body: This system records what you chose and when, but does not yet version the policy those choices were made against, so it cannot tell you whether a policy has changed since. Re-consent prompts will appear here once it does.

erasure.title: Erase your data
erasure.subtitle: This cannot be undone. Read what will happen, then confirm twice — once in writing and once with your password.
erasure.submitted_body: Your request is being processed in the background. You will be signed out shortly and will not be able to sign back in.
erasure.consequence_signin: You will be signed out and will not be able to sign back in.
erasure.consequence_profile: Your profile, preferences and linked accounts are removed.
erasure.consequence_sessions: Every active session and credential — passkeys, authenticators, tokens — is revoked.
erasure.consequence_retained: Records the law requires us to keep, such as security audit entries, are retained in anonymised form.
erasure.acknowledge: I understand this is permanent and cannot be reversed.
erasure.phrase_help: Type {{phrase}} exactly, to confirm this is deliberate.
erasure.password_help: Your password is checked before anything is deleted.
erasure.hard_delete: Remove my records entirely rather than anonymising them
erasure.hard_delete_help: Anonymising already satisfies your erasure right and keeps security audit trails intact. Choose full removal only if you need it.
erasure.failed: The request could not be submitted. If the password was wrong, try again — repeated attempts are rate limited.
erasure.final_warning: This is the last step. There is no undo.
erasure.footer: Prefer to keep the account but stop using it? Deactivating suspends access without destroying your data.

compliance.placeholder_body: The retention endpoint returns fixed values rather than querying the database. Do not use these numbers as audit evidence until it reports real counts.
